source: A little pause before she said that. And a little watchfulness after. Linou wanted to be sure I understood that Americans were welcome here.
translation: 她开口前顿了一下；说完，又留神看我的反应。莉努是要确认我听懂了：美国人在这里很受欢迎。

source: I did not enjoy it. We will speak of it no more.
translation: 我不喜欢。此事不必再提。

source: These are the black halls of sightless Sleep.
translation: 这是无目之眠的黑色厅堂。

source: [Winning hand] A natural!
translation: [赢牌] 天牌！
notes: natural 是百家乐起手两张合计八或九点的“天牌”；结合牌局上下文采用通行术语。

source: 'She said... you would open her eyes.' But the saint's eyes in the window are open. What did Jaume mean?
translation: “她说……你会让她睁开双眼。”可彩窗里圣人的眼睛本来就是睁着的。海梅是什么意思？

source: Here - I'm a citizen of the State.
translation: 看——我是邦国公民。

source: Of course. I'm still an ordained priest of the Church Solar...
translation: 当然。我依旧是太阳教会正式授职的司铎……

source: [Show French passport] Sylvain Huissier.
translation: [出示法国护照] 西尔万·于西耶。

source: This one changes the date... this switches to an unorthodox numbering schema... and this sets an alarm. Which might be useful.
translation: 这个会更改日期……这个会切换成一种非正统的编号方式……而这个会设置闹钟。或许有用。

source: I don't have time to fence with you, Rodia. Tell me or not.
translation: 我没时间和你绕弯子，罗迪娅。说不说随你。

source: Increase the flow from the hot tap.
translation: 调大热水龙头的水流。

source: How did it come here? Has someone been furnishing the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui with treasures from occult auctions?
translation: 它怎么会在这里？有人拿神秘学拍卖会上拍来的珍宝布置“今日”疗养院吗？

source: (Oh no.)
translation: （糟了。）

source: [Potential] Villas full of idiots, waiting for the war to kill them all.
translation: [潜在] 满是蠢人的别墅，等着战争把他们全杀光。
notes: Potential 为激情获取机制中的“潜在”选项，沿既有批次统一。

source: As you prefer.
translation: 随你。

source: Andrée, the bookseller, has a quieter business than books - she sells goods forbidden by the laws of the State. Search her shop and you'll find proof.
translation: 书商安德蕾还做着一门比卖书更安静的生意——她出售邦国法律禁止的货物。搜查她的店，你就会找到证据。

source: [Bet cautiously] Five francisques.
translation: [谨慎下注] 五弗朗西斯克。

source: [An awkward shrug.]
translation: [尴尬地耸肩。]

source: Right.
translation: 好吧。

source: 'A questing knight. Yes. I like that.
translation: “一位寻觅的骑士。”对。我喜欢这个说法。
notes: questing knight 呼应奥比耶将主角比作追寻目标的骑士，译为“寻觅的骑士”。

source: I have not. I'll return when I have.
translation: 还没有。等做完我会回来。

source: Although perhaps I'll find I've lost my taste for the quiet life, after so many years outside the world...
translation: 不过，在尘世之外待了这么多年，也许我已经过不惯清静日子了……

source: It's a coffee-pot?
translation: 是……咖啡壶？

source: Good day, Mr Strathcoyne.
translation: 日安，斯特拉思科因先生。

source: This is the State, Aristide.
translation: 这就是邦国，阿里斯蒂德。

source: In my time on the stage, I saw a great many secret doors, hidden compartments. I suspect there may still be a door here... aha!
translation: 在台上讨生活那些年，我见过无数暗门暗格。我就猜这里还藏着一道门……哈！

source: The [[Bureau]] believed that he was killed by a rising competitor. But a Winter-long like Coseley could not die before the date agreed with his patron - any more than he could live beyond that date.
translation: [[Bureau]]相信，他死在一名新近崛起的对手手中。但像科赛利这样的冬之长生者，不可能早于与庇护者约定的日期死去——正如他也不可能活过那一天。
notes: 保留 [[Bureau]] 链接；Winter-long 按位阶译为“冬之长生者”。

source: Pale as pearl.
translation: 苍白如珍珠。

source: Different gone?
translation: 另一种“没了”？

source: Travelling light, is it?
translation: 轻装旅行，是吗？

source: But you will be respectful when you call upon the Sanitarium. The director is a man of importance. Do not let me hear of you causing difficulties.
translation: 不过，去疗养院时给我规矩些。院长是位要人。要是让我听说你在那里生事……

source: It's even more striking than the one by the front door.
translation: 它比正门旁那幅更扎眼。

source: [View black market goods.]
translation: [查看黑市货物。]

source: [Potential] But I never had a chance to enjoy the Riviera in the golden years. I was stuck somewhere older and chillier.
translation: [潜在] 可我从没机会享受蔚蓝海岸的黄金年代。那时我困在一个更古老、更寒冷的地方。
notes: Potential 为激情获取机制中的“潜在”选项，沿既有批次统一。

source:
Jo koitti kuumon aika, ja viukkaat puhvenet
päinillä harpitellen kieruloivat,
haipeloina seisoksivat varakuhvenet,
ja öksyt muvut kaikki hinkuroivat.
translation:
Jo koitti kuumon aika, ja viukkaat puhvenet
päinillä harpitellen kieruloivat,
haipeloina seisoksivat varakuhvenet,
ja öksyt muvut kaikki hinkuroivat.
notes: 芬兰语荒诞诗句／本地化测试文本按原文保留，避免把未知既有译文误作原创。

source: ...health, the body, the soul's dwelling-place.
translation: ……健康；肉体；灵魂的居所。

source: Shut up, Aristide. Well, I knew I wasn't her favourite person, but... Heavens.
translation: 别说了，阿里斯蒂德。我知道她一直不待见我，可……老天。

source: [Leopold struggles to decide on an expression. Eventually, he grinds his teeth..]
translation: [利奥波德一时不知该作何表情。最后，他咬了咬牙……]

source: Go away. I will not speak with you.
translation: 走开。我不想和你说话。

source: A figurine: a woman in a long, bodiced dress.
translation: 一尊小像：一名身着束腰长裙的女人。

source: Hm. Elegantly incomprehensible.
translation: 嗯。优雅得令人费解。

source: You're these boys' governess, I take it?
translation: 我看你是这群小子的家庭女教师？

source: Thirty years ago in Brancrug, I met a man who called himself a signaire. Not a true adept - but he knew some tricks. Enough to break the laws of the world and the Church, doing little works among the people.
translation: 三十年前，我在布兰库格遇见一个自称西尼亚尔的男人。他并非真正的修习者——却懂得一些把戏。足以违逆世间与教会的法则，在民间行些小术。
notes: signaire 为法南方言式设定称谓，暂沿前批音译“西尼亚尔”。

source: How much will you pay me?
translation: 你会付我多少？

source: It's a little overwritten, I grant you, but the plotting is quite ingenious...
translation: 我承认，文笔稍微有些用力过猛，不过情节确实编得巧妙……

source: ...but I don't remember exactly.
translation: ……但具体怎么回事，我记不得了。

source: Sock juice?
translation: 袜子汁？

source: [Return the silver spintria.]I apologise. I submitted to an ignoble impulse.
translation: [归还银制春宫币。]抱歉。我一时没经住卑劣的念头。
notes: spintria 指古罗马情色图案代币，沿前批暂译“春宫币”；保留源文开头空格与方括号结构。

source: A half-guessed memory sparkles infuriatingly at the brain-lobe tip, and is gone. I can't work out what this is.
translation: 一段似曾相识的记忆恼人地在脑叶尖端一闪，便没了。我还是弄不清这是什么。

source: The circus came west from Genoa to the Côte d'Azur - which must have been when Nina stopped in at the Sanitarium.  Its route goes on along the coast through Marseille, Montpellier, Béziers. Then north into wilder regions. I've missed most of the dates, but it's due in the city of Mimata, in the mountains of Lozère. There should still be time to catch it there.
translation: 马戏团从热那亚一路向西来到蔚蓝海岸——妮娜一定就是在那时到过疗养院。路线沿海岸继续经过马赛、蒙彼利埃、贝济耶，再向北进入更荒僻的地区。我错过了大多数日期，但它预定会去洛泽尔山区的米马塔城。现在赶去，应该还来得及。

source: [A different ticket class?]
translation: [换一种车票等级？]

source: Keep it secret. I am a woman of importance. No-one reputable will believe you.
translation: 此事保密。我是有头脸的女人；体面人不会信你的。

source: She is unpardonable! A traitor, a slut, a defiler of husbands. Moral filth.
translation: 她罪不可赦！叛徒，荡妇，勾引有妇之夫的贱人。道德败类。

source: ESCAPE!
translation: 逃！

source: Well, I can almost hear the night saying, does anything? It has a point. I'd better hurry.
translation: 夜仿佛在我耳边问：世上有哪件事要紧？它说得也对。得快些了。

source: Curiosity. If I never know, just how much will I care?
translation: 好奇心。要是永远不知道——我究竟会多在意？

source: The arts of Bosk, of Hushery, of Skolekosophy are best worked in shadow.
translation: 丛林学、静默术与蠕虫学，最适合在阴影里施展。

source: It smells like sunlight on hot stone. As I lower the jar again, flashes of phantom light blur my vision.
translation: 闻起来，像阳光晒热了石头。放低罐子时，阵阵幻光闪过，视野随之模糊。

source: The cat's eyes fix upon me. Its stare is at once both terrified and indignant.
translation: 猫死死盯着我。那目光又惊又怒。

source: When you've learnt all that I have, my petitioner-thing, perspective will grant you new eyes.
translation: 待你学尽我所知，我的请愿之物，阅历自会赐你一双新眼。
notes: petitioner-thing 是西农布尔刻意非人化的称呼，译为“请愿之物”。

source: Gleaming cream and chrome. General Electric, one of the very brightest [[Incorporates]].
translation: 奶油色与铬钢闪闪发亮。通用电气——最为光辉的[[Incorporates]]之一。
notes: 保留链接结构；General Electric 使用通行中文名“通用电气”。

source: Yes. 'The centre cannot hold,' is how the Irishman put it. Things come apart, you know? Things fold together.
translation: 是啊。“中心再也无法维系”，那个爱尔兰人是这么说的。万物分崩离析，懂吗？万物又折叠在一起。
notes: 引语化用叶芝《第二次降临》，保留“中心无法维系”的母题。

source: The doc's a vegetarian. Rodia's always on a diet. The Strath doesn't like 'foreign food'. Though Vincent and Mat... those cats have appetites.
translation: 医生吃素。罗迪娅总在节食。斯特拉思科因不喜欢“外国菜”。不过文森特和马……那俩家伙胃口可不小。
notes: Mat... 为原文故意截断；cats 按口语“家伙”处理。

source: [Done]
translation: [说完]

source: It was a long time ago.
translation: 那是很久以前的事了。

source: Spend [q=cur:evolveCost] Knock Experiences.
translation: 花费 [q=cur:evolveCost] 份启之经历。

source: But it is too stubborn to leave. I suspect Bessy of feeding it.
translation: 但它赖着不走。我怀疑贝茜在喂它。

source: You said. Stop wasting my time. The trabai first.
translation: 你已经说过了。别浪费我的时间。先说trabai。

source: That's one of his. No-one knows what it means.
translation: 那是他的一首。没人知道是什么意思。

source: You said you had files on me. I'd like to see them.
translation: 你说有我的档案。我想看看。

source: Tweed-grey eyes, steady behind the spectacle lenses.
translation: 一双粗花呢灰的眼睛，隔着镜片沉稳地望来。

source: What questions?
translation: 什么问题？

source: Nod non-commitally.
translation: 不置可否地点头。

source: [Shameful.]
translation: [可耻。]

source: But of course I can't do that when Aubière is here.
translation: 可奥比耶在的时候，我当然不能这么做。

source: I'm looking for someone. A woman.
translation: 我在找人。一个女人。

source: [Keep my eyes on the floor. I don't want anyone to remember my face better than they have to.]
translation: [目光不离地面。没必要让谁把我的脸记得太清楚。]

source: The Sanitarium receives substantial funding from the European Recovery Program - the Acheson Mission - and from a semi-charitable Incorporate entity called the Meninger Foundation. Very substantial funding.
translation: 欧洲复兴计划——艾奇逊使团——以及一家名叫梅宁格基金会的半慈善法人团体，都给了疗养院大笔资助。好大一笔。
notes: Meninger 按源文拼写音译“梅宁格”。

source: Plenty else to talk about.
translation: 还有很多别的可聊。

source: Exit
translation: 退出

source: You too, chef.
translation: 你也一样，chef。
notes: chef 为文森特对主角的法语称呼，依多数既有批次保留原文。

source: For a time. When I return, I'll take my place in one of my kind's new cities. They should be well in progress by that time.
translation: 暂时而已。等我回去，会在同类的一座新城里安顿下来。到那时，新城该已初具规模。

source: Tell me your name.
translation: 告诉我你的名字。

source: Once I've travelled and returned to Antibes, I can refresh myself at Chez Felix again.
translation: 等我旅行一趟、回到昂蒂布后，还能再去费利克斯餐馆恢复精神。

source: Leopold tells me that his name will 'open doors' here. To your 'quieter business'.
translation: 利奥波德说他的名字在这里能“敲开门”——也就是你那门“安静生意”的门。

source: [Knowing] Dreams of a personal nature, you mean?
translation: [心知肚明] 你是说，私人的梦？

source: IMPORTANT YES THIS IS THE OPPORTUNITY TO RESPOND TO PASSION CHOICES YES
translation: IMPORTANT YES THIS IS THE OPPORTUNITY TO RESPOND TO PASSION CHOICES YES
notes: 全大写开发占位文本按原文保留。

source: The poinçonneuse is not flustered or confused. Her eyes are sharp and quick. Retreat. Regroup.
translation: 那位女检票员既不慌，也没被我绕晕。她眼疾心快。撤。重整旗鼓。
notes: poinçonneuse 指女检票员，翻译可见法语词并保留斜体。

source: Pithy, monsieur. Would that be Meillet? Bréal? But I am diverting you from your purchases. I apologise.
translation: 言简意赅，先生。是梅耶的说法？还是布雷阿尔？不过，我不该耽误您选购。失礼了。
notes: Meillet、Bréal 为语言学家姓名，暂译“梅耶／布雷阿尔”。

source: Why not pocket a few?
translation: 何不顺手拿几根？

source: [Wave the matter away.]
translation: [挥手示意无妨。]

source: Well, everything is long ago, since the Wars.
translation: 战争之后，一切都已是很久以前了。

source: [When I lift the drape, the light from beneath is enthrallingly bright. But I place the coin and step back before my mind can drift.]
translation: [我掀开帷幔时，底下透出的光亮得摄人心魄。但我趁心神尚未飘远，放下硬币，退后一步。]

source: Hurry to the platform.
translation: 快步赶往站台。

source: I'm sorry. The librarie is closed.
translation: 抱歉，书店打烊了。
notes: 源文 librarie 疑为故意或误拼的法语词，按语境译“书店”。

source: [Give my full attention to the coffee.]
translation: [全心品味咖啡。]

source: This is how such a cat would prefer to be touched.
translation: 这样才是这种猫喜欢的抚摸方式。

source: A pity the [[Mansus]] is barred to us both. I would like to speak more with your heart. It is rare to share [[History]] with one of your kind. But we'll have to make do with what's left.
translation: 可惜[[Mansus]]把你我拒之门外。我本想再同你的心谈谈。能与你这般存在共享一段[[History]]，实属难得。不过，只好拿剩下的将就了。
notes: 保留两处链接结构；History 的显示译名交由链接本地化。

source: It might have taken longer. 'We are never blind to stones, but we cannot see the earth.'
translation: 也许还会拖得更久。“我们从不对石头视而不见，却看不见大地。”

source: It must usually be reserved for regulars.
translation: 通常应该只给熟客。

source: [?] I do like their teeth. They have such wonderful teeth.
translation: [?] 我倒真喜欢他们的牙。那牙口可漂亮极了。

source: I'm high up - very high up. There is a flight of stairs, stretching down into the dark. It is light by torches. Someone will come. I will guard against them...
translation: 我在很高的地方——非常高。楼梯一路伸进黑暗，火把照着。有人会来。我得提防……

source: FNORD revisit the outline.
translation: FNORD 重看提纲。
notes: 开发占位文本；保留技术标记 FNORD。

source: It's rarely wise to attract the attention of the Milice.
translation: 招来民团的注意，通常不是明智之举。

source: [If I craft a Bewitch item before I go back to the bar... I could definitely make the drinks loosen their tongues.]
translation: [若在回酒吧前做出一件惑心器具……几杯酒准能替他们松松口。]
notes: Bewitch 制作物沿现有批次的 Bewitching 译法暂作“惑心物品”。

source: [The cat does not let down its guard. The eyes continue to blaze like frightened head-lights at night. But we have established diplomatic relations.]
translation: [那只猫没有放松戒备。双眼依旧像夜里受惊的汽车大灯一样灼灼发亮。但我们已经建立了外交关系。]

source: Be careful, [[pilgrim]]! When a gentleman comes calling dressed like that - a lady might misunderstand his aims.
translation: 当心，[[pilgrim]]！绅士穿成这样登门——女士可能会误会他的意图。

source: I wonder what I'd look like with Dundrearies? Or a neat little goatee?
translation: 我留一副邓德里厄式长鬓角会是什么样？或者整齐的小山羊胡？
notes: Dundrearies 指维多利亚时代夸张的长鬓角，暂译“邓德里厄式长鬓角”。

source: Here - I'm a citizen of the Republic.
translation: 看——我是共和国公民。

source: She wasn't as friendly, though.
translation: 不过她没这么友好。

source: [Exit, blushing.]
translation: [红着脸离开。]

source: Let's just call it a dream.
translation: 就叫它一场梦吧。

source: [Rodia sighs, very softly.]
translation: [罗迪娅极轻地叹了口气。]

source: Perhaps I'll have business there later.
translation: 也许以后我会去那里办事。

source: Mind your own business.
translation: 少管闲事。

source: [Give a slow smile, finish my drink, and stand up.]
translation: [缓缓一笑，喝完杯中酒，站起身。]

source: A ubiquitous and generic sort of name. Léon sneezes sceptically.
translation: 一个寻常得随处可见的名字。莱昂将信将疑地打了个喷嚏。

source: That's a little more than I was expecting.
translation: 比我预想的贵一点。

source: I am so grateful, monsieur. I will always remember you in my prayers.
translation: 先生，我感激不尽。我会永远在祷告中记念您。

source: With almost no pressure, the lid pops easily and unceremoniously out: the box is open. Inside, a little white ceramic jar.
translation: 几乎不用力，盒盖便轻易而干脆地弹了出来：盒子开了。里面是一只白色小陶罐。

source: '[[Henad]]', is it. No, you've lost me. Father.
translation: “[[Henad]]”，是吧。不，我听不懂了，神父。
notes: 保留 [[Henad]] 链接目标；神学术语显示名交由链接本地化。

source: Something seeping through. Everywhere leaks now. The [[Bureau]] must be overwhelmed.
translation: 有什么渗过来了。如今处处都在漏，[[Bureau]]怕是应接不暇。

source: A hygrometer quivers as I open the lid. Inside, a drawer full of crisply labelled cigars. It's a humidor - a storage box designed to preserve a suitable moisture level, so that the cigars neither dry out nor grow spongy.
translation: 湿度计在我掀开盖子时颤了一下。里面有个抽屉，装满标签整齐的雪茄。这是保湿盒——一种为保持适宜湿度而设计的储存盒，让雪茄既不干透，也不受潮发软。

source: That's not important. But if you'd seen her, you'd remember her.
translation: 那不重要。但你若见过她，一定会记得。

source: You said I would 'open her eyes'. The window? The saint? Or...
translation: 你说我会“让她睁开眼睛”。是那扇窗？那位圣人？还是……

source: A thousand francisques.
translation: 一千弗朗西斯克。

source: Saint Reparata's eyes.
translation: 圣雷帕拉塔的眼睛。

source: Yes, no, yes... it never works. It is never any good at all. Should know better by now. You are right, monsieur, of course you are right...
translation: 是，不，不，是……从来没用。一点用也没有。早该知道的。您说得对，先生，当然是您说得对……

source: ...let us not be hasty, M. Hobson.
translation: ……先别急，霍布森先生。

source: Nina travels with a circus. She left it to come here; she left here to catch up with it. The name of the circus was Rosa Mundi, and its next destination was the city of Mimata. That is as much as I know.
translation: 妮娜跟着一个马戏团旅行。她离开马戏团来到这里；又离开这里去追上它。马戏团名叫罗莎·蒙迪，下一站是米马塔城。我只知道这些。
notes: Rosa Mundi 沿前批统一为“罗莎·蒙迪”；明确 it 回指马戏团。

source: I see your point. I regret it. But some men are simply not suited to each other's company.
translation: 我明白你的意思，也确实后悔。可有些男人天生处不来。

source: [A look of clear disappointment flashes across Rodia's face, before she composes herself.]
translation: [罗迪娅脸上明显掠过失望，随即恢复了平静。]

source: Bessy is all right.
translation: 贝茜还不错。

source: Yes. What walked only in the night, walks in the daylight.
translation: 对。从前只走在夜里的，如今走在白昼。

source: I mean...
translation: 我是说……

source: Wasn't there another one like this, back by the door?
translation: 门边不是还有一幅类似的吗？

source: Near-silence. A burst of incoherent yelling from somewhere upstairs.
translation: 几乎一片寂静。楼上某处突然传来一阵含混的叫喊。

source: TO OUR DEAD, 1914-1919. Dark years, and darkness hangs here like smoke.
translation: 献给我等死者，1914—1919。那些年很黑；此地的黑暗仍像烟一样不散。

source: What a lot of tripe psychiatrists talk.
translation: 精神科医生说的废话可真多。

source: At last it's ready. Vapours coil from the clear water like angel snake ghosts.
translation: 终于好了。清水上蒸汽盘绕，像天使蛇的幽灵。
notes: angel snake ghosts 是刻意压叠的怪异意象，保留天使／蛇／幽灵三重并列。

source: One more thing. I'm looking for a woman named [[Nina Lagasse]]...
translation: 还有一件事。我在找一个叫[[Nina Lagasse]]的女人……

source: [Nod; leave.]
translation: [点头；离开。]

source: You're a philosopher?
translation: 你是哲学家？

source: I saw strange things, over where the rain ends.
translation: 我见过奇异的东西，就在雨幕尽头那边。

source: 'Guest'. And what if I want to leave?
translation: “客人”。要是我想走呢？

source: Beyond a prosaic and ragged edge of earth: a gulf, blue descending to black.
translation: 寻常而参差的土边之外，是一道裂隙：蓝色一路沉作黑色。

source: Leave.
translation: 走开。

source: [Preservation] Our blood was red... but theirs was golden.
translation: [保存术] 我们的血是红的……而他们的血是金色的。

source: Ask him about rue Pigalle some time. If he likes you, he might share some stories.
translation: 哪天问问他皮加勒街的事。若他喜欢你，或许会讲几段故事。

source: In this place, the sound is flat as stale water.
translation: 这里的声音，平得像一潭馊水。

source: I'm free of it.
translation: 我摆脱它了。

source: Perhaps where you're standing, you hybrid of mirk.
translation: 也许在你站着的地方是吧，你这幽暗的混种。
notes: hybrid of mirk 为西农布尔刻意含混的非人化称呼，暂译“幽暗的混种”。

source: Who is hollow of spirit and brazen of heart? Who has come here through iron and salt? I know you and name you, Lieutenant S.H. Now tell me in turn what I am.
translation: 谁魂魄空虚，心如黄铜？谁穿过铁与盐来到这里？我知晓你，叫得出你的名字，S.H. 中尉。现在轮到你告诉我：我是什么。
notes: hollow of spirit and brazen of heart 沿跨批统一译法“魂魄空虚，心如黄铜”；保留 name 的知晓／命名双关。

source: [Smile sheepishly.]
translation: [难为情地笑笑。]

source: 'In the name of the [[Beach-Crow]], who opens the earth, who sees what is lost...'
translation: “以[[Beach-Crow]]之名——祂掘开大地，洞见遗失之物……”
notes: 保留 [[Beach-Crow]] 链接目标；代词依 Hour 语境用“祂”。

source: 'Sylvain...
translation: “西尔万……
notes: 源文引语未闭合，译文保留悬断。

source: I'm a complicated man.
translation: 我是个复杂的人。

source: Our agreement still stands?
translation: 我们的约定仍然有效？

source: Do you know where?
translation: 你知道她去了哪里？

source: First class: two thousand francisques for two tickets, one thousand each.
translation: 一等座：两张票两千弗朗西斯克，每张一千。

source: Do you take me for an imbecile? Your lies insult us both. Go!
translation: 你当我是傻子吗？你的谎言既侮辱我，也侮辱你自己。滚！

source: The wooden panel is cold and smooth. Aubière is a man of powerfully focused reason.
translation: 木板冰冷光滑。奥比耶的理性强大而专注。
notes: 摆脱英语名词结构，同时保留 reason 的超常力量感。

source: [Back into town.]
translation: [回城里去。]

source: Brr! That's what you turn to thinking, when you spend all day in the dark.
translation: 嗬！整天待在黑暗里，就会想到这种事。

source: I've wanted a hot bath since I got off that damned train. No - since Milan. [Turn on the taps!]
translation: 我从那该死的火车下来后就一直想洗个热水澡。不——从米兰起就是了。[拧开水龙头！]

source: 'Spencer Hobson.'
translation: “斯宾塞·霍布森。”

source: Hm. Eh. Very well.
translation: 嗯。呃。好吧。

source: I apologise, madame. I am clumsy.
translation: 抱歉，夫人。我笨手笨脚。

source: What is his name?
translation: 他叫什么名字？

source: [Interrupt] Spit it out, man.
translation: [打断] 有话直说吧，医生。

source: Do I. Do I ever.
translation: 何止认识。

source: [Nod confidently.]
translation: [笃定地点头。]

source: Not if you drink your Coca-Cola. [Linou winks.]
translation: 喝了你的可口可乐，就不用担心。[莉努眨眨眼。]
notes: Coca-Cola 使用通行中文名；保留富文本。

source: No! I want more!
translation: 不！我还要！

source: Desist!
translation: 住手！

source: [Lie] 'Thunderskin?' I've never heard of it.
translation: [撒谎] “轰雷之皮？”我从没听说过。

source: Only that it's good to hear true patriots remembered. If you understand me.
translation: 只不过，听见有人记得真正的爱国者，实在令人高兴。你懂我的意思。

source: Do excuse me, Rodia. I have to go.
translation: 抱歉，罗迪娅。我得走了。

source: I'm sorry - sometimes, when a gentleman is dazzled by beauty, he fumbles his manners.
translation: 对不起——有时候绅士被美貌晃花了眼，就会忘了礼数。

source: Spencer. Going somewhere?
translation: 斯宾塞。要去哪儿？

source: Memories gossiping beneath a dome of echoes...
translation: 回忆在回声穹顶下窃窃私语……
notes: 保留源文行首空格与省略号节奏。

source: These rapscallions are drawing cards out of a woman's shoe and playing for small stakes. You're not going to lose your shirt. Or whatever other Outfit you're wearing.
translation: 这帮无赖从女人的鞋里抽牌，赌注也不大。输不掉你的衬衣——你穿的别的什么套装，也输不掉。
notes: Outfit 大写含游戏套装指涉，按笑话语境译“套装”。

source: I suppose.
translation: 我想是吧。

source: (Cube.)
translation: （老古板。）
notes: cube 是贝茜所用的四十年代美式俚语，指极端守旧、无趣的人，按口吻译“老古板”。

source: A poignant, graceful jazz piece - guitar, violin, double bass? -with a driving rhythm that somehow seems stately - almost like a waltz.
translation: 一首哀婉优美的爵士曲——吉他、小提琴、低音提琴？——节拍强劲，却偏有几分庄重，近乎华尔兹。
notes: 保留乐器猜测、插入语和层层修正的听感。

source: Well, you did keep dropping our tickets.
translation: 嗯，你确实一直在掉我们的车票。

source: Who?
translation: 谁？

source: [Through glistening streets, beneath blinded windows, past scar and wailing stone, and into the sun on the other side of town.]
translation: [穿过泛着水光的街道，经过紧闭双目的窗户、伤痕与哀鸣的石头，来到城镇另一头的阳光下。]

source: I am afraid that might in fact have been her intention. The animal is difficult to anticipate. It often interrupts my sessions with its... opinions. Even through two thicknesses of door.
translation: 恐怕那恰恰是它的用意。这畜生难以捉摸，常拿自己的……意见打断诊疗。隔着两道门都拦不住。

source: Long may his reputation survive without further tarnish.
translation: 愿他的声名从此长存，再不添污点。

source: I am a poor excuse for a poet, at best, [q=alias.title.fr].
translation: 我充其量只是个滥竽充数的诗人，[q=alias.title.fr]。
notes: 保留 [q=alias.title.fr] 变量。

source: It's obviously the honourable path.
translation: 显然，这是最体面的路。
notes: honourable 与激情“荣誉”呼应，保留机制词根。

source: And below the House - below the House -
translation: 而居屋之下——居屋之下——
notes: House 在设定语境指无墙之居屋，译为“居屋”。

source: Easily bored. You remember me. And there are people here I don't like so much.
translation: 我很容易腻。你还记得我；这里有些人，我可不大喜欢。

source: Rose-quartz, touched by sunset. Its touch sparks memories of the Western sea.
translation: 一块玫瑰石英，染着夕阳。碰触它，便激起我对西方大海的回忆。

source: Léon looks surprised, then delighted. He unfastens his truncheon from his belt.
translation: 莱昂先是惊讶，继而大喜。他从腰带上解下警棍。

source: The cat remains motionless on the sofa.
translation: 猫一动不动地待在沙发上。

source: We have already prepared Mlle Lagasse's room for a new guest. You'll find it upstairs.
translation: 我们已经把拉加斯小姐的房间收拾好，准备迎接新客人。你去楼上便能找到。

source: Out of the goodness of his heart?
translation: 因为他心地善良？

source: That's what I learnt. I was very young. But then the War. One of the battlefield exorcists trained me as his assistant. Father Stanislav.
translation: 我就是这么学来的。那时我很年轻。后来战争爆发。一名战地驱魔师训练我做他的助手。斯坦尼斯拉夫神父。
notes: Father Stanislav 暂译“斯坦尼斯拉夫神父”。

source: To Mimata, then. My heart surges urgently.
translation: 那就去米马塔。我的心催得很急。

source: You were a Bureau man, were you not? I used to make it my business to keep abreast of Bureau matters.
translation: 你从前在防剿局，是不是？防剿局的事，我向来留心。

source: I like happy endings.
translation: 我喜欢美满结局。

source: [Deception] I've done as you asked. Her dreams tonight will be the first of many miseries.
translation: [欺骗] 我已经照你说的做了。今晚的噩梦只会是她诸多苦难的开端。

source: It doesn't matter, his name. Names muddle me. Will you find him?
translation: 他的名字不打紧。名字总把我搅糊涂。你会找到他吗？

source: [Take my cheating somewhere else.]
translation: [换个地方出千。]

source: What did you say to me?
translation: 你刚才对我说什么？

source: You're gone from me now...
translation: 你已经离我而去……

source: And this is my third!
translation: 而这是我的第三杯！

source: I... sometimes, I fear the saint.
translation: 我……有时候，我害怕那位圣人。

source: An Hour of secrets. He knows the names of all the Dead.
translation: 秘密之司辰。死者的名字，祂全都知道。

source: The train runs to Mimata, and Mimata is where I'll find [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 火车开往米马塔；[[Nina Lagasse]]也在那里等我找到。

source: The honour is mine, Dr Aubière.
translation: 这是我的荣幸，奥比耶医生。

source: I think...
translation: 我想……

source: [The bleached room around me begins to flood with colour, as if paint had been dropped in clear water. I am returning to the waking world.]
translation: [四周惨白的房间开始涌入色彩，仿佛颜料滴进清水。醒时世界重现在我身边。]

source:
Emptiness is there to be filled. Appetite-focused choices are invariably selfish and often delightful.

[Evolve this Passion to Appetite, which contributes Edge and Grail to your Aspect Pool.]
translation:
空虚原就是用来填满的。顺从欲求的选择总是自私，也往往愉快。

[将这份激情演化为欲求；它会为你的性相池提供刃与杯。]
notes: Appetite 暂译“欲求”；严格保留段落和末尾双换行。

source: [Evade] Birds. You know how birds are.
translation: [回避] 鸟嘛。你知道的。

source: [Moth] Fascinating.
translation: [蛾] 真迷人。

source: You strike me as a man who understands the value of his time. Let me put a number to that value. [20 francisques]
translation: 你似乎很懂时间值多少钱。不妨让我替它开个价。[20 弗朗西斯克]
notes: 保留方括号中的价格结构；货币沿全局译“弗朗西斯克”。

source: [Out into the street.]
translation: [走到街上。]

source: 'Your outer self'. We will talk more about that later. But for now, tell me the dream.
translation: “你的外在自我”。这个以后再谈。眼下，先说说那场梦。

source: M. Janvier. It's good to see you again.
translation: 让维耶先生。很高兴又见到你。

source: We were speaking of Bricktop's, earlier. Of Django Reinhardt.
translation: 我们之前聊过布里克托普夜总会。还有姜戈·莱因哈特。
notes: Bricktop's 指巴黎夜总会，暂译“布里克托普夜总会”。

source: [Something opens to me.]
translation: [有什么向我敞开。]

source: I travelled third class from Alexandria. Never again.
translation: 我从亚历山大坐三等车来。再也不坐了。

source: Rodia's smile becomes more sardonic. She raises her skirt a little.
translation: 罗迪娅笑得愈发讥诮。她把裙子稍稍提起。

source: With no valid ticket, our only realistic choice is third class, where inspections are more cursory and distractions are plentiful.
translation: 没有有效车票，唯一还算实际的选择就是三等车厢：查票马虎，乱子也多。

source: [Funny-looking doodah.]
translation: [奇形怪状的玩意儿。]

source: I have the sense that someone in Alexandria mentioned something like this...
translation: 我隐约记得，亚历山大有人提过类似的东西……

source: Sylvain!
translation: 西尔万！

source: Perhaps, M. Hobson, we can discuss that later. For now - how may I assist you?
translation: 这个或许以后再谈，霍布森先生。眼下——我能为你做什么？

source: The shadowless light of the sun-cross chandelier above, the perpetual fire of the Unconquered Sun, the underwater glow of the stained glass windows, all make the altar bright.
translation: 头顶太阳十字吊灯的无影之光、不败太阳的永恒火焰、彩窗水底般的幽光，都落在祭坛上。

source: [Second class tickets] Spencer Hobson is not a third-class traveller.
translation: [二等车票] 斯宾塞·霍布森可不是坐三等车的人。

source: One thousand each for first class, five hundred each for second, two hundred and fifty for third. Vincent will contribute two hundred and fifty francisques.
translation: 一等座每人一千，二等座每人五百，三等座每人二百五十。文森特会出二百五十弗朗西斯克。

source: Lagasse, you say? Lagasse?
translation: 拉加斯，你说？拉加斯？

source: [Evade] Sounds dangerous.
translation: [回避] 听起来很危险。

source: A very bad book? Never mind, then.
translation: 一本非常糟糕的书？那就算了。

source: Serious adepts might sniff at the idea of kitchen rituals. But practitioners of Preservation know better. And Ithastry might be a high art, but you can get a lot done over an ordinary gas flame.
translation: 正经修习者也许会对厨房仪式嗤之以鼻。但保存术的修习者更懂其中门道。盗火术或许是一门高深技艺，可用普通煤气火焰也能办成许多事。

source: A sheaf of papers detailing a sacred scenario of the commedia della Sole.
translation: 一叠文稿，详述太阳喜剧的一出神圣情境。
notes: commedia della Sole 为设定内戏剧形式，暂译“太阳喜剧”。

source: If Monsieur wishes to threaten me again with the Milice, Monsieur can return when we are open again for business. In the decades to come.
translation: 先生若还想拿民团威胁我，大可等本店下次开张再来。也就未来几十年里的某一天吧。

source: Fada. [She shakes her head, chuckling.]
translation: 疯子。[她摇摇头，低声笑着。]
notes: Fada 为普罗旺斯方言“疯子／傻瓜”，结合莉努口吻译“疯子”。

source: The moonlight here is clear enough to make out the edges of the discoloured patch - of the texture of the paint.
translation: 此处月光清亮，足以看清褪色斑块的边缘，乃至漆面的纹理。

source: I agree to your revised proposal.
translation: 我接受你修改后的提议。

source: Hush.
translation: 别出声。

source: '[[Elegiast]].' I am not especially familiar with these esoteric doctrines.
translation: “[[Elegiast]]”。我对这类秘传教义所知不多。
notes: 保留链接结构。

source: What do you mean? That it isn't the twentieth century where you're standing?
translation: 你是什么意思？你站的地方不是二十世纪？

source: [American accent] Call me... 'Midnight Joe'.
translation: [美国口音] 叫我……“午夜乔”。

source: The dream of the wood. I don't like the dark.
translation: 林地之梦。我不喜欢黑暗。

source: [Edge/Knock] I remember my wounds in the Great War...
translation: [刃/启] 我想起自己在大战中受的伤……
notes: Edge／Knock 按准则译“刃／启”。

source: [Leave without a word.]
translation: [一言不发地离开。]

source: What in Heaven's... get out!
translation: 这究竟是……滚出去！

source: [Wary] ...I'll eat later.
translation: [戒备] ……晚点再吃。

source: I'm listening.
translation: 我听着。

source: 'I'll see you next decade.'
translation: “下个十年见。”

source: The other kind of night-work?
translation: 另一种夜间工作？

source: [I have no papers I'm willing to show the milicien.]
translation: [我没有愿意拿给这个民兵看的证件。]

source: Nothing. Though my fingers linger on the details of the feathers. This was shaped with love.
translation: 什么也没有。不过我的手指在羽毛的细节上流连。这东西是怀着爱意制成的。

source: I have not told you this.
translation: 我没告诉过你这件事。

source: Linou from the café suggested I talk to you. She told me you have a quieter business even than book-selling.
translation: 咖啡馆的莉努建议我来找你。她说你还做着一门比卖书更安静的生意。

source: Even the station's dim lights are brighter than the murk of Mimata town.
translation: 连车站黯淡的灯，也比米马塔城里的昏黑亮些。

source: This is what I wore to war.
translation: 这是我上战场时穿的衣服。

source: Use Nyctodromy to brew something that will let me walk in his dreams? That's a good idea, actually.
translation: 用夜游术调点东西，让我能走进他的梦？这主意倒真不错。
notes: Nyctodromy 依术语表译“夜游术”。

source: Poor fellow. Think of something sweet, and say it to him, for me.
translation: 可怜的人。替我想一句甜蜜的话，说给他听。

source: For the time being, I think we have said all there is to say on that matter.
translation: 眼下，我想这件事已经没有可谈的了。

source: Spend [q=com:evolveCost] Rose Experiences.
translation: 花费 [q=com:evolveCost] 份引之经历。
notes: 沿现有机制句式译“花费……份引之经历”，变量原样保留。

source: I heard Linou express clear Republican sympathies.
translation: 我听见莉努明确表示支持共和国。

source: Laughter is not forthcoming. Except for Aristide, who pounds the table and nearly chokes on his pipe.
translation: 无人发笑。只有阿里斯蒂德拍桌大笑，差点让烟斗呛着。

source: 'Mademoiselle'?
translation: “小姐”？

source: Do you believe in curses?
translation: 你相信诅咒吗？

source: I'm afraid, [q=alias.first], the games are finished for today.
translation: 恐怕今天的牌局到此结束，[q=alias.first]。

source: Do you know Rodia?
translation: 你认识罗迪娅吗？

source: [Martyr's palm; saint's halo.]
translation: [殉道者的棕榈枝；圣人的光环。]
notes: martyr's palm 指殉道圣人图像中的棕榈叶。

source: A dreamily smiling, dreamily humming woman in horn-rimmed glasses. Delicious scents waft from the kitchen behind her: ham, onions.
translation: 一个戴角框眼镜的女人，笑得恍惚，哼得也恍惚。厨房从她身后送来诱人的香味：火腿、洋葱。

source: [There's something more here...]
translation: [这里还有别的东西……]

source: Ah! le Révérend Père William Wright. On the Hittites.
translation: 啊！威廉·赖特神父阁下。论赫梯人的那篇。
notes: le Révérend Père 为带戏谑色彩的法语尊称，译“神父阁下”。

source: I dare not contradict madame la marquise.
translation: 我岂敢反驳侯爵夫人。

source: So... are you going to do it? Put a curse on me?
translation: 所以……你要动手吗？对我下个诅咒？

source: Churchills? Cuban cigars? I haven't seen those in France since the war.
translation: 丘吉尔雪茄？古巴雪茄？战后我在法国就没见过。

source: No answer. The shape is gone.
translation: 无人回应。那形影消失了。

source: Yes. I enjoyed her talent for stripes.
translation: 对。我喜欢她驾驭条纹的本事。

source: ...bloody awful, isn't it? Let's get stuck in.
translation: ……真他妈糟透了，不是吗？那就来管一管吧。
notes: Compassion 选项中的 get stuck in 表示动手帮助，保留主角突然粗口的降调。

source: I wondered whether I could be of any assistance to the Milice. I have experience as a private inquiry agent.
translation: 我在想，能否为民团效劳。我做过私人调查。

source: I am threatening Aubière. Here I am in his secret thoughts. I will drag us both into madness if I must. We will both regret it. Scarlet darkness writhes at the edges of what we both see.
translation: 我在威胁奥比耶。此刻，我就在他最隐秘的思绪里。必要时，我会把我们一同拖进疯狂。到头来谁都后悔。猩红的黑暗在我们共同所见的边缘扭动。

source: FNORD Enclosure! You're not allowed.
translation: FNORD 禁区！你不能进。
notes: 开发占位文本，保留技术标记 FNORD。

source: Perhaps she's buying stolen goods. Perhaps a supplier has lent her the fridge to keep his stock fresh. Either way, it suggests black market connections.
translation: 也许她在买赃物。也许供货人把冰箱借给她，替自己保鲜存货。不管怎样，这都表明她和黑市有来往。

source: The world's a big place...
translation: 世界这么大……

source: Léon seizes my arm, glaring, to drag me back the other way.
translation: 莱昂抓住我的手臂，怒目而视，要把我拖回另一边。

source: My hair and collar are gritty with coal-dust.
translation: 我的头发和衣领里全是煤灰，摸起来沙沙的。

source: I wonder if you mean your heart has imposed upon you? Sometimes I think that Strathcoyne's arm must be an imposition. But I find you more appealing than that man.
translation: 你是说，那颗心成了你的累赘？有时我觉得，斯特拉思科因那条胳膊想必也是他的累赘。不过，比起那男人，你倒讨人喜欢得多。
notes: 以“累赘”承接 heart/arm 的 imposition 双关，避免直搬英语施事结构。

source: Delighted.
translation: 幸会。

source: Will she recover?
translation: 她会康复吗？

source: It won't be stuck. I can get out.
translation: 它不会卡住。我能出去。

source: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。

source: You've met that toothsome Mathis. He's the one that calls it 'Annabelle' - the arm. But don't tell Fraser - for I swear the man is humourless as beef.
translation: 你见过那个秀色可餐的马蒂斯了。就是他管那条胳膊叫“安娜贝尔”。不过别告诉弗雷泽——我敢说那男人像牛肉一样毫无幽默感。
notes: toothsome 与 humourless as beef 均为罗迪娅刻意肉感化的调情／嘲弄，保留“秀色可餐／像牛肉”。

source: [It never hurts to make friends.]
translation: [交朋友总没坏处。]

source: Let 'em guess.
translation: 让他们猜去。

source: Step back through to Aubière's outer office.
translation: 退回奥比耶的外间办公室。

source: [A human-height block of something brilliantly luminous, almost hidden beneath a heavy velvet drape. Damp spots on the drape, drops of water on the floor, a hazy chill in the air of the room, all suggest that the 'something' is ice.]
translation: [一块与人等高、光芒灿烂的东西，几乎完全藏在厚重的天鹅绒帷幔下。帷幔上的湿斑、地板上的水滴、房间空气里朦胧的寒意，无不表明那“东西”是冰。]
notes: 严格保留整段方括号结构。

source: Fear and fascination war and wane. [[Dread]] and [[Fascination]] cancel each other out. If you have more of one than the other, it might cause dreams before it fades.
translation: 恐惧与迷恋交战，此消彼长。[[Dread]]与[[Fascination]]会相互抵消。若其中一方多于另一方，它也许会在消退前引发梦境。
notes: 保留 [[Dread]] 与 [[Fascination]] 链接目标。

source: Time to leave Mimata?
translation: 该离开米马塔了吗？

source: Then we will see you later. Perhaps.
translation: 那么，后会有期了。也许。

source: I'm looking for a former patient of yours. [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 我在找你从前的一名病人。[[Nina Lagasse]]。

source: Goodbye, Madame Zèlia.
translation: 再见，泽莉娅夫人。

source: Sniff it.
translation: 闻一闻。

source: [Don't mention the cigars.]
translation: [不提雪茄。]

source: Orderlies come and go.
translation: 护工来来去去。

source: Certainly.
translation: 当然。

source: [Rose] Inviting.
translation: [引] 令人神往。
notes: Rose 为准则标签，依术语表译“引”。

source: New cities?
translation: 新城？

source: Ambergris: vulgarly called 'whale vomit'. Valuable, though. It has uses in unconventional medicine. I picked up a lump, once, walking on the beach in [[Brancrug]].
translation: 龙涎香，俗称“鲸鱼呕吐物”。不过很值钱，非正统医学也用得上。我曾在[[Brancrug]]的海滩上散步时捡到一块。
notes: 保留链接结构。

source: Good morning.
translation: 早上好。

source: But there's something about getting off a train in the rain that makes me miss that little rite: moment of fire between cupped hands.
translation: 可在雨中走下火车，总会让我怀念那小小的仪式：拢起双手，其间一点火光。

source: Aristide is the noisy one.
translation: 阿里斯蒂德是吵闹的那个。

source: Regrettably I have none, but I think the Director will want to see me nevertheless.
translation: 很遗憾，我没有预约。不过我想，院长还是会想见我。

source: ...manifesting here in a scrine...of ice?
translation: ……在这里显现在一座……冰制龛壳里？
notes: scrine 沿较多既有批次暂译“龛壳”，指灵体寄居、显现的媒介。

source: Brr.
translation: 嘶，好冷。

source: I remember that I remarked on it; and he told me that it was a 'prefigure', done before the war by one of the Librarians of the place - someone who had the knack of copying work by other artists. But he'd copy the work before they'd ever actually painted it.
translation: 我记得自己还提过它；他告诉我，这是幅“先行之作”，战前由那里的某位司书画成——那人很会摹仿其他画家的作品，只不过总在原作者真正动笔之前便先摹了出来。
notes: prefigure 暂沿前批译“先行之作”，保留其先于原作的悖论。

source: The bath-water cools gently. At some point, I wrinkle. At last, the bath-water is entirely cold, and the joy of it is gone.
translation: 浴水渐渐凉下去。不知何时，我的皮肤泡皱了。最后，浴水彻底冰冷，乐趣也荡然无存。

source: [My heart pulses with desperation. The night responds. Give in to that desperation.]
translation: [我的心因绝望而悸动。夜晚作出回应。向那绝望屈服。]

source: [Hold it just out of reach.]
translation: [举在他够不到的地方。]

source: [Careful] I will look for him.
translation: [谨慎] 我会找找他。

source: The proprietress raises her head suddenly as I step towards the door.
translation: 我走向那扇门时，女店主猛然抬起头。

source: On the basis of our long acquaintance, I asked for nothing on account. In these many years, I abandoned the matter of the new suit: I apologise. However. I believe I have your old uniform here, in the back.
translation: 凭我们多年的交情，我没有收订金。新西装的事拖了这么多年，我早已不再指望做成：抱歉。不过，你的旧制服应该还在后面。

source: The Stars.
translation: 群星。
notes: Stars 大写且指俄国事件背后的异常存在，沿其他批次译“群星”。

source: This again...
translation: 又来了……

source: We are privileged to have an artist of Mme Vlachou's stature as our guest.
translation: 能让弗拉胡夫人这样的艺术家成为我们的客人，实在荣幸。

source: An elegant argument, monsieur.
translation: 论证得很漂亮，先生。

source: I travelled third class from Alexandria. Slatted wooden benches and students bawling drinking-songs. Sometimes, cages of chickens. Just once, a small but desperately plaintive goat. I didn't get much sleep.
translation: 我从亚历山大坐三等车来。条板木凳，学生们扯着嗓子唱酒歌。有时还有装鸡的笼子。有一次是一只小山羊，个头不大，叫声却哀怨得不得了。我几乎没睡。

source: She wishes only to see.
translation: 她只想看见。

source: Lie back, close eyes... whisper 'Sinombre' three times. [This won't be restful, and you won't lose Troubles.]
translation: 躺下，闭眼……低声念三遍“西农布尔”。[这不会让你休息好，也不会消除麻烦。]
notes: Troubles 在睡眠机制中暂译“麻烦”；方括号结构完整保留。

source: 'Antibes. Before War came to the World, this was the sweet blue eye of the Riviera. Yachts and parties and film-star villas. Picasso painted Pierrots, here by the sea...'
translation: “昂蒂布。在战争降临世界之前，这里是蔚蓝海岸甜美的蓝眼睛。游艇、派对、影星别墅。毕加索曾在这里的海边画下皮埃罗……”

source: There is no sugar.
translation: 没有糖。

source: I need no appointment. My business is of the highest importance.
translation: 我不需要预约。我的事务至关重要。

source: Yes; I must confess that I am. I had hoped you would be able to open the box. I did not expect you to succeed so... anticlimactically.
translation: 是的；不得不承认，确实如此。我原是盼你打开盒子，却没想到你开得如此……全无戏剧性。
notes: anticlimactically 译“波澜不惊”，保留奥比耶对开盒过于轻易的失落。

source: [Take a cigarette from the packet.] Light?
translation: [从烟盒里抽一支烟。] 有火吗？

source: [Out through the rain-curtain, into bright sunlight.]
translation: [穿过雨幕，走进灿烂的阳光。]

source: This is perhaps a very old pyx. Or, one source has it, a reliquary - with a relic perhaps of St Galileo himself. In any case it has proven difficult to open. I am reluctant to damage it.
translation: 这也许是一只很古老的圣体盒。或者，据某份资料说，是只圣物匣——里面或许装着圣伽利略本人的遗物。无论如何，它很难打开。我不愿损坏它。
notes: pyx 结合献祭圣体语境译“圣体盒”，reliquary 译“圣物匣”。

source: Here - I'm a subject of her Majesty.
translation: 看——我是女王陛下的臣民。

source: I do not offer credit to strangers, monsieur. Be quick, or I will speak to my friends.
translation: 我不赊账给陌生人，先生。快点，不然我就要叫朋友了。

source: He was in Paris during the occupation. An Enemy officer saw Guernica on the wall of his apartment. 'Did you do that?' the officer asked.
translation: 占领时期，他人在巴黎。一名敌军军官在他公寓墙上看见了《格尔尼卡》。“这是你干的？”军官问。
notes: Guernica 为毕加索画作，译《格尔尼卡》并保留斜体。

source: [Roll eyes.]
translation: [翻白眼。]

source: 'The Light of the World.' Holman Hunt's controversial but radiant depiction of the Shepherd-Illuminate as the [[Watchman]]'s avatar.
translation: 《世界之光》。霍尔曼·亨特笔下备受争议却光辉照人的牧者·启明者，乃[[Watchman]]的化身。
notes: Shepherd-Illuminate 为教会称号，暂译“牧者·启明者”；保留 [[Watchman]] 链接目标。

source: Humm. I suppose we'll see.
translation: 嗯。那就等着瞧吧。

source: Upholstery! Antimacassars! And slightly less chance of official interference.
translation: 软垫！防油椅背巾！而且受官方干涉的可能稍微小些。
notes: antimacassar 指防止发油沾染的椅背巾，译“防油椅背巾”。

source: I've seen this painting before...
translation: 我见过这幅画……

source: (They would. I made unwisely unambiguous references to the invisible world. The [[Bureau]] shut down the production on opening night. I was lucky to stay out of prison.)
translation: （会的。我不明智地直白提到了无形世界。[[Bureau]]在首演当晚便叫停了演出。我能免于入狱已属幸运。）
notes: 保留 [[Bureau]] 链接目标。

source: Sylvain. All right, chef. [Vincent chortles.]
translation: 西尔万。好吧，chef。[文森特咯咯笑。]
notes: chef 为文森特的法语称呼，保留原文。

source: [Watch them.]
translation: [盯着它们。]

source: We were? I remember that you mentioned this Lagasse. But I remember no discussion.
translation: 是吗？我记得你提过这个拉加斯。但不记得我们讨论过她。

source: A large blond gentleman in orderly's whites blocks the hallway listening to a portable radio. He raises his eyes to regard me without enthusiasm.
translation: 一个穿白色护工制服的金发壮汉堵在走廊里，正听着便携式收音机。他抬眼看我，兴味索然。

source: Of course, Doctor. I'm sorry to have troubled you.
translation: 当然，医生。抱歉打扰你。

source: We would have been married, Felix and I, in the summer.
translation: 我本来会在夏天嫁给费利克斯。

source: She tosses her head. Her eyes are like flecks of beach-glass.
translation: 她猛地扬起头。眼睛像海玻璃的碎片。

source: Part of it.
translation: 有一部分。

source: You are not the one I summoned. The signaire. Go away from here.
translation: 你不是我召来的那个人。那个西尼亚尔。离开这里。
notes: signaire 沿前批音译“西尼亚尔”。

source: You must. I will suffer this woman no longer.
translation: 你必须做。我再也受不了这个女人。

source: [That said, you're not in the Suppression Bureau any more. You need to find Nina. You could use the money.]
translation: [话虽如此，你已经不在防剿局了。你必须找到妮娜。你也用得上这笔钱。]

source: Leave it alone.
translation: 别管它。

source: Her name is [[Nina Lagasse]]... and I'm certain you'd remember her.
translation: 她叫[[Nina Lagasse]]……而且我敢说，你一定记得她。

source: There. We have what we need.
translation: 好了。我们所需的东西已经齐了。

source: He likes you, Vincent.
translation: 它喜欢你，文森特。

source: [Turn an imaginary key in the lock of my mouth; drop the imaginary key into Aristide's pastis.]
translation: [把一把想象中的钥匙插进嘴锁，转动；再把想象中的钥匙丢进阿里斯蒂德的茴香酒。]

source: [Truth] Say rather a friendly campfire, Aristide. [Nod at his pipe.] I'll see you again.
translation: [真话] 不如说是友好的篝火，阿里斯蒂德。[朝他的烟斗点点头。] 再会。

source: This isn't a Milice poster.
translation: 这不是民兵团的海报。

source: Close to the station, there is a bookseller. Andrée.
translation: 车站附近有一家书店。店主叫安德蕾。

source: This entity is dormant - or its attention is elsewhere.
translation: 这个实体陷入了休眠——或者它的注意在别处。

source: Wait. What's happ -
translation: 等等。怎么回——

source: [Lean close] No more than they deserved.
translation: [凑近] 这是他们应得的。

source: That pétasse Griotte stole him. Took him to another city.
translation: 那个叫格里奥特的贱货把他偷走了。带去了另一座城。
notes: pétasse 为泽莉娅的粗俗辱骂，按人物口吻译“贱货”。

source: [Aloud] They'd looked too long at the sun. One could see nothing through her left eye, one was blind in her right. So St Columba cast sea-water on a fire, and when the steam of it had cleared, so had their sight.
translation: [大声说] 她们望着太阳太久。一个左眼什么都看不见，一个右眼失明。于是圣科伦巴把海水泼到火上；蒸汽散去时，她们的视力也恢复了。
notes: 保留两名双胞胎左右眼相反失明及海水蒸汽治愈的镜像结构。

source: [Put it away.]
translation: [收起来。]

source: Vincent is all right.
translation: 文森特还不错。

source: Well, Nina has left us, that much you must know. The Director dreams brightly of why. Would you walk in his dreams, then? To learn of her fate? If you offer me what I must have?
translation: 嗯，你至少该知道，妮娜已经离开了。院长的梦把缘由映得清清楚楚。那么，你愿不愿走进他的梦，查明她的去向？只消献上我非要不可的东西。
notes: Sinombre 的条件性提议保留诱导与含混，不擅自说明代价。

source: And I am Philomèle.
translation: 我是菲洛梅勒。

source: If you had spent the last ten in the world - I can't say if you'd understand much more. We all of us have changed.
translation: 即便过去十年你都待在世间——我也说不准你会多明白多少。我们全都变了。

source: Sylvain. Going somewhere?
translation: 西尔万。要去哪儿？

source: The cat remains safely out of reach on the piano's summit.
translation: 猫稳稳占据钢琴顶端，待在够不着的地方。

source: [The train whisle blows. The conductor is walking down the carriage, wearily bellowing. 'Mimata' he cries as he passes our compartment.]
translation: [火车汽笛响起。列车员沿车厢走来，疲倦地高声呼喊。他经过我们的隔间时喊道：“米马塔。”]
notes: 源文 whisle 为拼写错误，按 train whistle 译“火车汽笛”；保留整段方括号结构。

source: Aye. Dark times. But Dr Aubière sees to it for me.
translation: 是啊。世道艰难。不过奥比耶医生会替我安排。

source: That's it. 'American champagne', Aristide calls it.
translation: 就是那个。阿里斯蒂德管它叫“美国香槟”。
notes: American champagne 为阿里斯蒂德对 Coca-Cola 的戏称，译“美国香槟”。

source: I remember. At the Sanitarium, they said you'd arrived with Nina, didn't they? Interesting. Let's take a look at you...
translation: 我想起来了。疗养院的人说，你是和妮娜一起到的，对吧？有意思。让我瞧瞧你……

source: But it is a such a little sin, is it not, M. Hobson? I hardly think you would wish to waste the time of the police with this. And I am a man of some standing in Antibes.
translation: 可这不过是桩小罪，不是吗，霍布森先生？我想，你不会愿意拿这种事浪费警察的时间。而我在昂蒂布也算有些身份。

source: [Lift the camomile tea that Linou added to the tray for me.]
translation: [举起莉努为我添在托盘上的甘菊茶。]

source: Examine the glyphs closely to determine their function.
translation: 仔细检查这些符号，判断其功能。

source: Deal me in.
translation: 算我一个。

source: [Back to the hallway.]
translation: [回到走廊。]

source: Where she goes, she is remembered.
translation: 她所到之处，都会有人记得她。

source: No. Turn back, Zèlia. This will twist your soul.
translation: 不。回头吧，泽莉娅。这会扭曲你的灵魂。

source: And?
translation: 所以呢？

source: I am curious indeed. But I think I will reserve such commerce for my waking hours.
translation: 我确实好奇。不过这种交易，还是留到醒着的时候再谈。

source: [Bet confidently] Ten francisques.
translation: [自信下注] 十弗朗西斯克。
notes: 货币与前批统一为“弗朗西斯克”。

source: You are the signaire? I am Zèlia. Do not ask my family's name.
translation: 你就是那个西尼亚尔？我是泽莉娅。不要问我的姓氏。
notes: signaire 沿前批音译“西尼亚尔”，保留斜体与问号位置。

source: [Possessed] Years ripe with opportunity. I could have made my mark.
translation: [已有] 那些年机会正好。我本可以留下自己的印记。
notes: Possessed 在激情获取机制中表示已经持有该激情，沿既有批次统一译“已有”。

source: You'll be Hobson, then.
translation: 那你就是霍布森了。

source: Fade out, then in
translation: 淡出，再淡入

source: Yes. Yes. I only wish I could see her when the pain begins.
translation: 是。是。我只恨不能亲眼看着她开始受苦。

source: A cheering rush of hot water, and the air begins to cloud with steam.
translation: 热水欢快地涌出，空气渐渐蒙上蒸汽。

source: [We'll both travel in first class! Pay one thousand seven hundred and fifty francisques. Vincent will pay towards his own ticket.]
translation: [我们两个都坐一等车！支付一千七百五十弗朗西斯克。文森特会为自己的车票出一份钱。]
notes: 严格保留方括号、金额和文森特分担票款的信息。

source: No-one mentioned them.
translation: 没人提过。

source: To put it bluntly: yes.
translation: 直说吧：对。

source: The animal is essentially inert, monsieur. Expect nothing of him.
translation: 这畜生基本不会动，先生。别指望它。

source: These cigars look sumptuous. I have to try them. Pocket a few.
translation: 这些雪茄看着就阔气。非试不可。揣几根。

source: Nyctodromy, Horomachistry, Birdsong: once I'd have gone to a crossroads to call them up. But this is just as good.
translation: 夜游术、司辰学、鸟鸣学：从前我会去十字路口召用这些技艺。不过这里也一样合适。

source: Just... go get us something to drink, eh?
translation: 就……去给我们弄点喝的，好吗？

source: She misses her country, and her husband. But I don't know how much is left of those - either of them - and she likes it here. 'Out of the cold,' she says. And the doctor is helping her with the pain.
translation: 她想念自己的国家，也想念丈夫。但我不知道那二者——无论哪一个——如今还剩下多少。她倒喜欢这里。她说，这里“远离寒冷”。医生也在帮她缓解疼痛。
notes: out of the cold 是罗迪娅的原话，保留其对故乡、疾病与温暖的多重含义。

source: I wanted to see what would happen.
translation: 我想看看会发生什么。

source: [Craft] To work.
translation: [制作] 干活。

source: Go on.
translation: 继续说。

source: [Nod.]
translation: [点头。]

source: Eh... why not. There's worse things than people.
translation: 呃……为什么不呢。总有比人更糟的东西。

source: And so neither can we know if I'm right, eh? But, thank you.
translation: 所以，我们同样无法知道我说得对不对，是吧？不过，还是谢谢你。

source: There is no point. There doesn't need to be. It's how things are.
translation: 没有意义。也不必有意义。事情就是如此。

source: One hundred thousand francisques.
translation: 十万弗朗西斯克。

source: Hot water. Steam. Shaving cream. This is civilisation.
translation: 热水。蒸汽。剃须膏。这就是文明。

source: Perhaps it was sunset when the bear died. Perhaps the scent of pines.
translation: 也许那头熊死时正值日落。也许空气里有松树的气味。

source: Halfway through a wry aside to Jean-Bernard, Philomèle begins to cough. It takes a long time for the coughing to subside. She's grown very pale. It might be that there's a spot of blood on her collar. I can't be certain. The fabric is dark, and so is the rainy, smoky, friendly gloom of the café.
translation: 菲洛梅勒正说到一半，侧头对让-贝尔纳挖苦了一句，忽然咳起来。许久才停。她脸色惨白，衣领上或许沾了一点血。我拿不准：衣料太暗，咖啡馆里那片雨水、烟雾与亲切交织的昏暗也太深。

source: Always. But now a subject of the doctor's realm.
translation: 一直是。不过如今只是医生领地里的臣民。

source: Quell with a trygikon or a midnight mark
translation: 用 trygikon 或午夜印记平息
notes: 测试／技术文本；保留未明术语 trygikon，midnight mark 暂译“午夜印记”。

source: Chemin-de-fer - railway. You know it?
translation: Chemin-de-fer——铁路。你懂吗？
notes: Chemin-de-fer 既是法语“铁路”也是牌戏名，保留法语并直陈字面义以维持双关。

source: ... I don't know. It's unknowable. So I don't know.
translation: ……不知道。这无从知道。所以，我不知道。

source: Lulled by the train's sway, I slip into a deep sleep...
translation: 火车摇着摇着，我便沉沉睡去……

source: [Read]
translation: [阅读]

source: This document would be satisfactory... except that you told me, earlier, that your name was [q=alias.last]. This is an entirely different name.
translation: 这份证件原本没有问题……只不过你早些时候告诉我，你姓 [q=alias.last]。这上面是个完全不同的名字。
notes: 保留 [q=alias.last] 变量。

source: Aristide. Please.
translation: 阿里斯蒂德。拜托。

source: Much better.
translation: 好多了。

source: Mm. I hope you found your seaside stay restful.
translation: 嗯。希望你在海边休养得不错。

source: [Odd that she was so reluctant to offer this...]
translation: [奇怪，她怎么这么不愿意拿出这个……]

source: Good to be on the move again. I think I might have outstayed my welcome, here!
translation: 又能上路，真好。我想自己在这里待得太久，已经不招人待见了！

source: I noticed some, ah, gaps in Antibes. Do you know what they are?
translation: 我注意到昂蒂布有一些，呃，缺口。你知道那是什么吗？

source: I'm sorry.
translation: 抱歉。

source: Night campaign.
translation: 夜战。
notes: 结合奥比耶询问从军经历的上下文，Night campaign 直译“夜战”，保留含混和主角的简短应答。

source: Pillows straight. There.
translation: 枕头摆正。好了。

source: An Hour of forbidden appetites. He inspires his votaries to consume the flesh of the dead...
translation: 一位司掌禁忌欲望的司辰。他会激励信徒食用死者之肉……

source: A complicated memory stirs...
translation: 一段复杂的记忆翻涌……

source: Lay a hand on the bear's fur.
translation: 把手放在熊的毛皮上。

source: He called the owl 'Ubu'.
translation: 他叫那只猫头鹰“乌布”。

source: 'The gate to its temenos is a beast-image in the hidden chamber of the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui...'
translation: “通往其圣域的门，是‘今日’疗养院隐秘房间里的一尊兽像……”
notes: temenos 指神圣围域，译“圣域”；Sanitarium Aujourd'hui 沿前批译“‘今日’疗养院”。

source: With the right tools - or the right assistance - his dreams might be open to me.
translation: 有合适的工具——或合适的协助——我或许能进入他的梦。

source: One Charlemagne asked: how can you stand to wear American uniforms?
translation: 一个查理曼师士兵反问：那你们又怎么受得了穿美国制服？
notes: Charlemagnes 指敌军占领时期查理曼师的法国志愿兵，明确译“查理曼师士兵”。

source: Nothing. Good day.
translation: 没什么。日安。

source: Your turn.
translation: 轮到你了。

source: Jaume's eyes crinkle in his habitual melancholy nearly-smile.
translation: 海梅眼角微皱，露出他惯常忧郁、近乎微笑的神情。

source: In some buildings, there are doors that appear on no plan, through which only the drunk or distracted ever pass. Is there one here?
translation: 有些建筑里存在图纸上没有的门，只有醉汉或心不在焉的人会穿过去。这里也有一扇吗？

source: This Nina - what does she look like?
translation: 这个妮娜——她长什么样？

source: Mademoiselle, I am invariably careful.
translation: 小姐，我向来小心。

source: Thanks, chef. Travelling like gentleman!
translation: 谢谢，chef。像绅士一样旅行！
notes: 保留文森特略不标准的口语和法语称呼 chef。

source: [Yes, this is clearly acceptable. Quite acceptable.]
translation: [是的，显然还算合意。相当合意。]

source: Thanks, Bessy.
translation: 谢谢，贝茜。

source: She, ah, wanted to commission me to put a curse on you.
translation: 她，呃，想委托我对你下咒。

source: The work of moments to brush a little bewitchment around the rims of the glasses.
translation: 只消片刻，几只杯沿便沾上了一层淡淡的惑心。
notes: bewitchment 沿本批 Bewitch／Bewitching 暂译“惑心术”。
